_description: Top-level manifest of the project-local Agency-to-Structure Engine instances in this repo. Per the three-layer model, each instance has its own folder under .project-intelligence/, its own LOOM_PROJECT_ID, and MUST NOT share memory or context with other instances.

watches: Class information (course name, term, schedule, instructors)
Repeated confusion (same conceptual question across sessions)
Learning workflows the student uses repeatedly
instances.boundary: Student-facing agency only. MUST NOT share memory or context with a paired developer-facing instance (e.g., a -dev instance of the same project).
